question: How do we usually start a friendly letter to our friend? ✉️
explanation: Super! We usually begin a letter to someone we care about with the word 'Dear', like 'Dear Sam'! 💖
hint: It is a sweet word we use for loved ones.

question: Who do we write a sick leave application to at school? 🏫
explanation: Awesome! We write an application to the Principal when we cannot go to school! 👩‍🏫
hint: This person is the head of the school.

question: What do we write at the very end of our application? ✍️
explanation: Great job! We always sign our own name at the bottom so they know who wrote it! 📝
hint: It is what people call you.

question: Which words do we use to close a formal school application? 🏫
explanation: Brilliant! 'Yours obediently' is a respectful way to close a letter to your teacher or Principal! 🙇
hint: It means you follow the rules and respect them.

question: Where do we usually write the date on an application? 📅
explanation: Awesome! We write the date near the top so the reader knows when we wrote it! ⬆️
hint: Look up high on the page.

question: If you have a fever, what do you ask the Principal for? 🤒
explanation: Super! We ask for 'Sick Leave' so we can rest at home and get better! 🛏️
hint: It means taking time off to rest.

question: What do we call the big middle part of the letter where we write our message? 💬
explanation: Great job! 'The Body' contains the main message or reason for writing the letter! 📝
hint: It shares a name with your physical form.

question: What do we write right below 'To The Principal'? 🏫
explanation: Awesome! We write the School Name to show which school the Principal leads! 🏢
hint: It is the place where you go to study.

question: How do we end a loving letter to our parents? 👨‍👩‍👧
explanation: Super! We use 'Yours lovingly' for family and friends because we love them! 💖
hint: It has the word 'love' in it.

question: What is a paragraph? 📝
explanation: Great job! A paragraph is a group of sentences that talk about one main idea! 📚
hint: It has many sentences together.

question: How should the first word of a paragraph start? 🔠
explanation: Awesome! We always begin the first word of a sentence and paragraph with a Capital letter! 🔠
hint: It is a big letter.

question: What do we put at the end of a telling sentence in our paragraph? 🛑
explanation: Super! A full stop tells the reader that the sentence is finished! ⏺️
hint: It looks like a tiny dot.

question: When ordering a story, which word shows the starting step? 🏁
explanation: Brilliant! 'First' tells us what happens at the very beginning of the story or paragraph! 🥇
hint: It means number one.

question: Which word comes after 'First' when explaining steps? ➡️
explanation: Great job! We use 'Then' or 'Next' to show what happens after the first step! ➡️
hint: It shows the very next action.

question: Which word tells us the paragraph or story is ending? 🔚
explanation: Awesome! 'Finally' means it is the last step or the end of the story! 🔚
hint: It sounds like 'final'.

question: What is the very first thing we say to the Principal in an application? 👩‍🏫
explanation: Super! We use 'Respected Principal' to show honor and good manners! 🙏
hint: It shows that we respect them.

question: If you are going to a cousin's wedding, what do you need from school? 🏫
explanation: Awesome! We must write a Leave Application to tell the school why we are absent! 📝
hint: It is a letter asking for a holiday.

question: Read this: 'I woke up. I brushed my teeth.' Which sentence comes first? 🌅
explanation: Great job! You have to wake up first before you can brush your teeth! 🥱
hint: Think about what you do right after sleeping.

question: Who reads your sick leave application in school? 🏫
explanation: Super! Your Teacher or Principal reads it to know why you are not in class! 👩‍🏫
hint: They teach you and run the school.

question: If you need to stay home for two days, what do you write? 🗓️
explanation: Awesome! You ask for 'Two days leave' if you need exactly two days to rest! ✌️
hint: You ask for the exact number of days.

question: How do you start a letter to your mother? 👩‍👧
explanation: Great job! 'Dear Mom' is a sweet and loving way to start a letter to your mother! 💖
hint: It uses a sweet word and her name.

question: What is the best title for a paragraph about your pet dog? 🐶
explanation: Super! The title tells us what the paragraph is about, so 'My Pet Dog' is perfect! 🐕
hint: It should have the word 'Dog' in it.

question: What is the best title for a paragraph about where you study? 🏫
explanation: Awesome! 'My School' is the right title because it tells the reader you will write about your school! 🏫
hint: It is the place where you learn.

question: When you write a paragraph about yourself, what is it called? 👦
explanation: Brilliant! When you describe yourself, the paragraph is called 'About Me' or 'Myself'! 🙋‍♂️
hint: It is about you.

question: What do we call the name of a story or paragraph? 🏷️
explanation: Super! The Title is the name of the story, written at the very top! 👑
hint: It tells us what we are going to read.

question: Sentence 1: 'The sun is hot.' What is a good Sentence 2? ☀️
explanation: Great job! Sentences in a paragraph must match! Summer matches the hot sun! 🏖️
hint: Think of the season when it is very hot.

question: 'I like eating apples.' This belongs in a paragraph about what? 🍎
explanation: Awesome! Apples are fruits, so it belongs in a paragraph about Favorite Fruits! 🍏
hint: Apples are a type of food.

question: 'A cat meows loudly.' This sentence belongs in a paragraph about? 🐈
explanation: Super! A cat is an animal, so this fits perfectly in an Animals paragraph! 🐾
hint: Cats, dogs, and lions are all part of this group.

question: Who do we write informal letters to? ✉️
explanation: Awesome! Informal or friendly letters are for people we are close to, like Family and Friends! 👨‍👩‍👧
hint: People you love and play with.

question: Who do we write formal applications to? 📝
explanation: Great job! Applications are formal, so we write them to respected people like our Principal! 👩‍🏫
hint: The people who teach you at school.

question: What is a nice way to close a letter to your Grandpa? 👴
explanation: Super! You love your Grandpa, so you write 'Yours lovingly' at the end! 💖
hint: Use a word that shows your love.

question: Where do we stick the postage stamp? ✉️
explanation: Awesome! A stamp goes on the corner of the envelope so the postman can deliver it! 📩
hint: It holds the letter inside.

question: Who carries our written letters to our friends far away? 🚶‍♂️
explanation: Great job! The Postman delivers our letters and mail to the correct houses! 📬
hint: This person wears a uniform and carries a mailbag.

question: What tells the Principal the main reason for the application in one short line? 📌
explanation: Super! The 'Subject' is a short line that quickly tells why we are writing! 📝
hint: It is a short title for the letter.

question: What is the best 'Subject' for a fever application? 🤒
explanation: Awesome! The subject 'Sick Leave' tells the teacher right away that you are unwell. 🛏️
hint: It shows you need rest.

question: Where do we write 'I am not feeling well' in the application? 🤒
explanation: Brilliant! The full message goes into the middle part, called 'The Body'! 📝
hint: It is the biggest part of the letter.

question: What does 'Kindly grant me leave' mean? 🙏
explanation: Great job! It is a very polite way to say 'Please give me a holiday'! 😌
hint: It is a polite request for a day off.

question: How should the title of a paragraph be? 🏷️
explanation: Super! A title should be short and easy to understand! ✨
hint: It should not take up too many words.

question: Sentence 1: 'I have a pet.' Sentence 2: 'His name is Max.' Is this a good order? 🐶
explanation: Awesome! It is perfect! First you introduce the pet, then you say his name! ✅
hint: It makes perfect sense in this order.

question: To call a friend to your birthday, what do you send? 🎂
explanation: Great job! We send an 'Invitation' to ask someone to come to our party! 🎉
hint: It invites them to come over.

question: An invitation to a birthday party is what type of letter? 🎈
explanation: Super! Birthday invitations are fun and sent to friends, so they are Friendly letters! 👦
hint: It is for your buddies.

question: We use 'Yours faithfully' when we write to? 🏫
explanation: Awesome! 'Yours faithfully' or 'obediently' is a formal sign-off for school teachers or Principals! 👩‍🏫
hint: Important people at school.

question: We use 'Dear Papa' when writing a/an? 👨
explanation: Great job! Writing to family is always a fun, informal letter! ✉️
hint: It is a casual, loving letter.

question: When starting a brand new paragraph, what do we sometimes leave at the start of the line? ⬅️
explanation: Brilliant! We often leave a little space (indent) to show a new paragraph is starting! 📏
hint: It looks like a little gap.

question: Read this: 'I went to school. I packed my bag.' Which should happen first? 🎒
explanation: Awesome! You have to pack your bag first, and THEN you go to school! 🎒
hint: You need your books before you leave home.

question: Read this: 'We played games. We cut the cake.' What is this paragraph about? 🎈
explanation: Super! Games and cutting a cake mean it is a super fun Birthday Party! 🎉
hint: It has cake and games!

question: Where do we write 'Thank you' in our sick leave application? 🙏
explanation: Great job! We say 'Thank you' at the bottom of the letter to be polite before we sign our name! ⬇️
hint: It goes near the bottom.

question: When we write our name at the bottom of the letter, it is called our? ✍️
explanation: Awesome! Writing your name to show you wrote it is called your Signature! 📝
hint: It is how you write your name.

question: What goes inside the envelope before you give it to the postman? ✉️
explanation: Super! We put the folded Letter inside the envelope to keep it safe! 📄
hint: The paper you just wrote on.

question: If you are writing to your friend Rahul, how should the greeting look? 👋
explanation: Great job! 'Dear Rahul' is the perfect and friendly way to greet your buddy! 👦
hint: Use the sweet word for friends.
